basis.note: a beam end with nothing to bear on; no code threshold (tolerance is a modelling tolerance)
not cited by any code: AISC has no prescribed span/depth table (serviceability is deflection-based); 20-24 is a widely cited preliminary-sizing rule of thumb, 24 at its upper end

warning_ratio.note: the tightest case, used because continuity is not extracted; crossing it means the code requires a deflection calculation (ACI 24.2), not that the member is deficient

critical_ratio.note: reuses the code's own both-ends-continuous figure (L/21) as an 'even the most lenient real code condition is exceeded' heuristic, not a cited critical value in its own right

basis.note: partially informed: ACI 318-19's concrete cantilever exemption is h >= L/8 (span/depth <= 8), tighter than 12; this rule is material-agnostic, so 12/16 is kept pending a material-split cantilever rule
